title: Phone cover gestures and component lessons verified
summary: Completed the interrupted cover interaction and verified mouse/touch event handling, organized component lessons, mode switching and learning progress.

changes.detail: Double-click/double-tap and accessible Open cover / Replace cover button, with English, French and Arabic instructions.
Cover mode removes the display layer to expose hardware; topics are organized into power, processing, image/sensors and connections/sound learning groups.
Pending lesson taps are canceled by rotation, dragging, mode changes and next-topic navigation. Ignore secondary buttons and unrelated pointers.
Regression checks for cover gestures, physical component hit targets, grouping, mode transitions and drag rejection in all three languages.

validation.name: Phone Lab and history regression tests
validation.detail: 10 tests passed (4 Phone Lab tests and 6 history tests). Phone tests passed again after extra pending-tap, secondary-click and keyboard-rotation assertions. All three languages exercise mouse/touch double gestures, cover replacement, 9 internal component hit targets, grouped topics, empty-stage taps, drag cancellation, mode switching, quiz and progress.

validation.name: TypeScript and focused ESLint
validation.detail: npm.cmd run typecheck and npx.cmd eslint utils/phone-explorer-document.ts utils/phone-model-renderer.ts completed successfully. Used .cmd launchers after PowerShell blocked npm.ps1/npx.ps1.

validation.name: Open phone model visual inspection
validation.detail: Inspected artifacts/phone-cover-inside.png, generated by replaying canvas commands through SVG to PNG. Exposed components are visible and contained in the frame. This is a model render, not a live app screenshot. Font cache warnings did not prevent rendering.

validation.name: History integrity
validation.detail: Append and --check preserved all 187 reports present before this verification follow-up.

validation.name: Live browser, native WebView and release
validation.detail: Live app layout and physical device gestures were not tested. No deployment or APK rebuild performed; installed releases need a rebuild to receive local changes.
